method.quantiles: Exact nearest rank on unrounded observations
method.intervals: Equal-tail 95% binomial order-statistic intervals, mode-centered probability recurrence
method.intervalAssumptions: Marginal intervals assume independent observations; no simultaneous familywise coverage or proof of independent physical runs
method.allowance: Baseline maximum minus minimum, applied beyond the observed baseline range to every candidate run
method.throughput: Successes divided by time from measurement start through the later of measurement end and terminal completion
method.resourceAttribution: Run-level service counters; cohort guards cover latency, errors, throughput and generator lag
method.improvement: Both global p99 endpoints must have disjoint intervals beyond baseline spread; at least one resource cost must improve in every candidate run beyond baseline spread
